records.name: KeepBox 18 Gallon Clear/Green
notes: Internal length and width use Akro-Mils' published bottom dimensions; height uses the full-line catalog's published inside height.

Akro-Mils' current product page markets this as an 18 gallon KeepBox; its current full-line specification table lists 17 gallons. capacity_ml preserves the marketed nominal 18 gallon value and this discrepancy is retained here.
Akro-Mils lists a 35 lb contents capacity and four-high stack quantity; max_load_g stores the contents capacity, not stacking strength.
